days.title: Arrival & golden hour
days.blurb: Late sun over the harbor. Ease in — the 35mm and a slow walk.

days.title: Geysir & Gullfoss
days.blurb: Time the burst; freeze or blur the spray. Wind decides for you.

days.title: Black-sand beaches
days.blurb: The dark sand fools matrix metering bright. Dial negative exposure comp.

days.title: Seljalandsfoss & Skógafoss
days.blurb: Silky or frozen — pick before you set up. Watch the spray on the front element.

days.title: Glacier lagoon & Diamond Beach
days.blurb: Ice is a highlight trap — protect the sparkle, let the shadows go.

days.title: Icelandic horses
days.blurb: AF-C, 3D tracking, shutter floor 1/500s. Let them come to you.

days.title: Whale watching
days.blurb: Boat + telephoto + cold spray. Fast shutter, burst mode, patience.

days.title: Dim interiors
days.blurb: Turf houses and lava caves — high ISO is the tool, noise is fine.

days.title: Long vistas
days.blurb: f/8 sweet spot, hyperfocal, level horizon. The 35mm earns its keep.

days.title: Drive west
days.blurb: Split light on the peninsula — half the frame dark, half bright.

days.title: Eclipse scouting day
days.blurb: Pick the spot, verify the timeline, save U1/U2, rehearse the sequence.

days.title: ECLIPSE DAY
days.blurb: Totality 17:45:46. Filter on for partials. Bracket the corona. Look up.
